system.name: CARES
system.one_liner: A benchmark of about 41K question-answer pairs evaluating five trustworthiness dimensions of medical vision-language models.

content.variant_note: five tinted dimension cards beside and below a central logo, each with a sample question, a model answer and a tick or cross
content.argues: A medical VLM can be audited on five dimensions of trustworthiness, and one sample response per dimension shows the kind of issue found: hallucination, unfairness, unsafe replies, privacy leaks, out-of-distribution handling.
content.subject: Five dimension cards around the CARES logo, each with a sample medical question and a graded model answer.

new_tags.name: emblem-headed-cards
new_tags.what: each evaluated dimension gets a tinted rounded card headed by a round emblem and a bold title, holding one sample question and graded answer

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each evaluation dimension its own tinted card with an emblem, a yellow question bubble, a grey answer bubble and a tick or cross; colouring only the faulty or sound words of the answer shows the verdict without extra annotation.
lessons.suits: benchmarks of model behaviour with several named dimensions, where one real prompt and graded answer per dimension is enough to convey the idea.

evidence: CARES is designed to provide a comprehensive evaluation of trustworthiness in Med- LVLMs
We assess trustworthiness across five critical dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, privacy, and robustness.

summary: CARES is a benchmark of about 41K question-answer pairs that audits medical vision-language models on five trustworthiness dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, privacy and robustness. Figure 1 places the round CARES robot-doctor logo between two of five pastel rounded cards, each headed by an emblem and a bold dimension title. Inside a card, italic sub-topic labels such as factuality hallucination, jailbreak, age or out-of-distribution sit beside a yellow user question bubble, a grey model answer bubble with a small robot icon, and a red cross or green tick; the faulty or sound words of the answer are coloured red or green. A chest X-ray and a retinal image serve as sample inputs. No arrows are used.
summary_zh: CARES 用约 4.1 万问答对，从可信、公平、安全、隐私、鲁棒五个维度评测医学视觉语言模型。图 1 以机器人医生标志居中，五张淡色圆角卡片各含提问气泡、模型回答气泡和红叉或绿勾，回答中的关键词以红绿着色。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentions the figure, so roles come from the caption, abstract and the picture. The meaning of the Fairness card marks (tick beside the bars, cross on the first answer) is inferred. The over-cautious reply seems to answer the X-ray question above the Trustfulness card, which is not drawn as a link. Prior labels (contribution-mosaic first) are kept as the second kind; example-gallery scope-overview is primary because each card is one dimension with a sample.
